messages:
sara_partnerships: Quick thread — Vela (partner) asked about listing a quantized model + appliance bundle in our cloud marketplace. Need to lock on what redistribution terms + artifacts we require before we let them host.
vela_partner: hi all! we can provide quantized weights, a short provenance manifest, and a signed redistribution memo. hoping to avoid heavy paperwork. timeline: next month.
tony_legal: TL;DR: we need a redistribution addendum (one page) or explicit license grant in writing. Also must capture dataset sources and any embargo/export flags.
mei_marketplace: Policy note: hosted marketplace items must include: license file, checksums, contact email, and a clear "hosting" label (hosted vs. download-only). Hosted images require stricter attestations.
rob_engineering: Engineering checklist (short): weights SHA256, tokenizer file, model-card JSON (fields: arch, quantization, memory estimate), and an attest file (signed or notarized). We'll run a sandbox deploy preflight.
vela_partner: sample model-card OK to share?
rob_engineering: sample snippet: `{ "name": "vela-3b-q4", "quant": "int4-ptq", "weights_sha256": "<sha256>", "tokenizer": "spm", "approx_vram_mb": "3000" }`
artifact-bot: scan 4592: missing license.txt in preview bundle. see https://ci.internal/artifacts/4592 for logs.
tony_legal: If base model license is permissive (Apache/MIT) redistribution allowed with attribution. If copyleft, need explicit redistribution permission in the addendum. We'll prepare a one-paragraph fallback clause for notarized attestations for previews.
mei_marketplace: UX plan: add a "redistribution-OK" badge and a hover card linking to the addendum PDF. For hosted bundles we show "hosted-by: vela" vs "hosted-by: redwood".
sara_partnerships: Actions: tony draft addendum template, rob build verify script + model-card template, mei add badge + hosting label, vela to submit manifest + license. Target: draft for partner review in 5 business days.
vela_partner: thanks! we'll aim to upload manifest + license by EOD Wed. Notarized attestation acceptable for preview, will work toward cryptographic signature for GA.
sara_partnerships: Great. If anyone sees edge cases (third-party escrow, embargoed dataset sources, unclear provenance), flag here and we'll escalate to legal. :eyes:
